content:
name: Temporary EXEC-0010 projection cleanup

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/exec-0010-projection-cleanup

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out EXEC-0010 governance branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: eose/exec-0010-result-close-20260907
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
      - name: Regenerate projections after temporary workflow removal
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
      - name: Publish projection cleanup
        run: |
          git add machine .eos/trace-edges.tsv
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(machine): finalize EXEC-0010 closure projections"
            git push origin HEAD:eose/exec-0010-result-close-20260907
          fi
